description: Set the thermal properties of the block zone constitutive model. Gating: requires model configure thermal. Probe trap: with any first token other than 'property' the live engine reports 'block zone thermal: command not found' (misleading - the command exists); unconfigured it reports 'Not configured for thermal calculations'.

keywords.name: property
keywords.description: Set thermal properties of the block zone constitutive model. Property names (official 9.7 page; conductivity state-verified live: 'Thermal property conductivity set in 48 zones'): conductivity, conductivity-x, conductivity-y, conductivity-z, specific-heat, expansion.
